free_tier.stated: No free tier. ClinePass is a flat USD 9.99/month subscription giving 2-5x the API rate limits of standard access; it is optional and a separate provider from Cline usage-billing.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters usage, not objects

retention.stated: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference; no caller-stored bytes

egress.terms: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference

tooling: Cline IDE extension, Cline CLI, and any OpenAI-compatible client sending an X-Response-Format: openai header
chaining: one flat-rate key shared across all ClinePass models; usage is metered by a rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly cap

identity_cost.detail: a Cline account dashboard subscription; the page shows a Subscribe link and a card-backed monthly plan but does not enumerate signup fields

reliability_note: model deprecations are performed for capacity reasons (GLM-5.2, Kimi K2.6, K2.7 Code and DeepSeek V4 Flash were removed)

evidence.proved: ClinePass is a paid monthly subscription at USD 9.99 with no free tier

evidence.quote: ClinePass measures usage against three limits:
evidence.proved: usage is bound by a 5-hour rolling window plus weekly and monthly limits

evidence.quote: It's completely optional. You don't need ClinePass to use Cline
evidence.proved: ClinePass is optional and separate from Cline usage-billing
